TELEX · UPDATED 21 OCTOBER 2026

Privacy, plainly.

This website

The interactive previews are animations in your browser. They do not access your microphone, camera or screen. This site adds no analytics scripts or account system. The hosting provider may process requests and enforce its access controls.

Your scripts stay on your Mac

The current Telex app stores scripts and settings locally. It has no backend, analytics or cloud synchronization. You choose the destination for exported scripts and recordings.

Permissions belong to you

No-microphone prompting needs no microphone, camera, Speech or screen-recording permission. Voice-level pacing needs the microphone. Optional script-word following needs Apple Speech authorization, a supported on-device language and available system speech assets. The current app requires on-device recognition and has no network recognition fallback. Screen recording is separate and requests screen access only when you choose that feature. Recording audio is separately optional. Telex does not activate a camera for prompting.

Screen sharing has limits

Stealth is best effort and marked Limited on macOS 15 or later. Telex cannot guarantee exclusion from third-party full-display capture. Share an individual application window, use another display or hide the panel. Built-in display recording is configured with a ScreenCaptureKit exclusion filter; actual output must be checked with a test recording. macOS privacy indicators and the app name cannot be hidden.

A development build, openly labelled

The available download is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. Gatekeeper release assessment has not passed, and macOS may block opening it. Do not rely on this build for an important recording without testing and backups.

Live speech-following accuracy, capture behavior in Zoom, Meet, Teams and OBS, interrupted recording recovery, comprehensive accessibility testing and sustained performance validation remain incomplete. A dedicated Manual mode and built-in camera recording are not implemented. Automated test results do not establish that every hardware workflow or security requirement passes.

Recording responsibly

Record only with necessary consent and permission. The native app has its own terms and separate OS permission controls. Downloading the app here does not accept those terms or grant permissions.
